claim_one_line: THE PHYSICAL LANE'S TWO SEALED PACKETS ARE NOT ACCEPTED FOR EXECUTION AS SEALED (P-746, R80-6). Custody holds in full (63 of 63 and 41 of 41 pins hash to their sealed values, at the seal and at the lane's head). The mathematics holds for its bounded, conditional claims as far as it was read and re-derived (64 table rows re-derived by two readers, none failed). Three substantive findings remain, each a method whose pass would be read as more than it tests: packet 2's holonomy block cannot fail (its transport series is formed for two multiples of one matrix); packet 1's code never builds E8's bracket (a sign flip on the two spinor modules passes every relation checked); one method named for an index cancellation computes no index. Main departs on purpose from B1787, where caveats of the same kind were accepted: a caveat travels worse than a repaired check. What a reseal needs is listed, seven items, and main reviews a reseal by its difference. 0 of 19.
